questions.question: How is student safety best maintained as a general rule?

options.text: Let some students leave the bus while others stay.

questions.explanation: In most emergencies, students are safest when they stay on the school bus. Keeping them on board helps you maintain control.

questions.question: What should the overhead inside mirror show?

options.text: The outside of the driver's side of the bus.
Students in the first four rows.

questions.explanation: Adjust the overhead mirror to see the top of the bus's rear window. This lets you see all students, including those sitting right behind you.

questions.question: How do you get points against you during the basic control skills test?

options.text: Exiting the vehicle once to check your position.

questions.explanation: The examiner counts every time your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line. Each touch or crossing is an error against your score.

questions.question: How far back does a blind spot extend behind a school bus?
questions.explanation: A school bus has blind spots below the mirrors, in front of the mirrors, and behind the bumper. The rear blind spot usually extends 50 to 150 feet back, but can reach 400 feet depending on bus length.

questions.question: When checking air and electrical lines, which is NOT acceptable?

options.text: Air hoses making a hissing noise.
Air hoses and electrical lines are not cut.
Air lines are not dragging on tractor parts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Air hoses making a hissing noise.
questions.explanation: Check air and electrical lines for leaks. They should not be cut, chafed, spliced, or worn. They should not be tangled, pinched, or dragging on tractor parts.

questions.question: What should you check about the pedals during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Something is under the brake pedal.

questions.explanation: Make sure nothing is under or around the pedals that will stop them from working. Check that the pedals work properly and have grooved surfaces if needed.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, the landing gear should be:

options.text: More worn on the passenger's side.

questions.explanation: Check that the landing gear has no missing parts and is fully raised. The crank handle should be secure and the support frame should not be damaged.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on an expressway during the skills test?

options.text: Use mirrors to check traffic as needed.
Drive on the left side of the lane.
Drive faster than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use mirrors to check traffic as needed.
questions.explanation: During expressway driving, keep proper lane position, distance from other vehicles, and speed. Check your mirrors constantly to see traffic all around you.

questions.question: What should you do when crossing railroad tracks?
questions.explanation: Do not stop, change gears, pass, or change lanes while any part of your bus is on the railroad crossing.

questions.question: When picking up students, why should you park at least 10 feet away?

options.text: Students must walk to the bus so you can watch them better.
It is hard to get closer to the students.

questions.correctAnswerText: Students must walk to the bus so you can watch them better.
questions.explanation: Park with the front bumper at least 10 feet from students. This makes them walk to the bus, so you can see and watch their movements.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Pull forward into a parking space.

questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: The front of an enclosed trailer should:
questions.explanation: When inspecting an enclosed trailer, check the front area for damage such as cracks, bulges, or holes.

questions.question: When should you inspect the mirrors on a bus?

options.text: Is not necessary to inspect the mirrors.

questions.explanation: Inspect the bus mirrors before you start driving. Adjust them as needed before beginning your trip.

questions.question: When asked to complete a driver's side parallel parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pass the parking space while backing, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
Pull forward into the parking space without passing it first.
Back into the parking space without passing it first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on your left, then back into it. Bring the rear of your vehicle as close to the rear of the space as possible. Your vehicle should be completely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: When you are approaching a bus stop, the students on your bus should:

options.text: Stand up and collect their belongings.
Walk to the front of the bus and prepare to exit.

questions.explanation: Students should stay seated until told otherwise. It is unsafe for students to walk around while the bus is moving.

questions.question: When driving through a curve during the skills test, you should:

options.text: Veer from your lane if needed to complete the curve.
Reduce your speed after entering the curve.
Refrain from looking for other vehicles while turning.
Reduce your speed before entering the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed before entering the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve so you do not need to brake or shift while in the curve. Keep your vehicle in its lane and watch for traffic in all directions.

questions.question: Before leaving a bus stop, a driver should:

options.text: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus.
Make sure students have placed their backpacks in the aisle.
Make sure students have opened the emergency vent.
Make sure students are facing the rear of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus.
questions.explanation: Before pulling away from a bus stop, check that no students are running to board the bus.

questions.question: At a passive railroad crossing:

options.text: The decision to proceed rests with each driver.
The decision to proceed should be based on a control device.
The decision to proceed should be based on surrounding vehicles.
The decision to proceed is left to passengers in each vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The decision to proceed rests with each driver.
questions.explanation: Passive railroad crossings have no traffic control devices. Each driver must decide when it is safe to cross the tracks.

questions.question: There are blind spots ____ left and right side flat mirrors.
questions.explanation: There are blind spots immediately below and in front of each outside flat mirror. There is also a blind spot directly behind the rear bumper.

questions.question: During the steering box portion of the vehicle inspection test, you should not:

options.text: Ensure that the steering box is securely mounted.
Ensure that the steering box is free of leaks.
Look for missing bolts in the steering box.
Assume all cotter keys are present.

questions.correctAnswerText: Assume all cotter keys are present.
questions.explanation: Check that the steering box is securely mounted. Look for missing nuts, bolts, and cotter keys. Make sure there are no power steering fluid leaks and no damage to power steering hoses.
